item.title: The Xichang launch scheduled for 26 Nov 2026 carries a numbered Yaogan or Shiyan payload
item.summary: Whether China's state media or CASC name the payload of the Long March 2D that Launch matched to closure areas A6099/26 (ZPKM) and A6100/26 (ZGZU) as a Yaogan or Shiyan satellite with a series number.

alternatives.hypothesis: Class 1: a numbered Yaogan (遥感) series
alternatives.tell_apart: Xinhua or CASC names the payload 遥感 followed by a number

alternatives.hypothesis: Class 2: a numbered Shiyan (试验) series
alternatives.tell_apart: named 试验 followed by a number (Shiyan 30-05/06 would continue the pairs launched 29 Sep 2025 and 12 Mar 2026 on the same bearing)

alternatives.hypothesis: Class 3: another Chinese government or state-company series (Xinjishu Shiyan, satellite-internet or communications technology test satellites, Shijian, Tianhui, Gaofen, Ziyuan, a science mission, SatNet/Guowang)
alternatives.tell_apart: named in one of those series

alternatives.hypothesis: Class 4: a commercial company's or a foreign customer's payload (Jilin-1, SuperView, PIESAT, Geely, foreign)
alternatives.tell_apart: named for a company constellation or foreign customer
no state-media or CASC payload name by 09:35 UTC 28 Nov

resolution.rule: Yes if, within 48 hours of lift-off, Xinhua, CCTV, CASC or CNSA names the main payload of the orbital launch from Xichang matched to closure areas A6099/26 ZPKM and A6100/26 ZGZU (or to replacement notices for the same launch) as 遥感 (Yaogan) or 试验 (Shiyan) followed directly by a series number, for example 遥感四十三号 or 试验三十号. No if it is named any other way, including 新技术试验 (Xinjishu Shiyan) and any name in which 试验 follows another word, such as 卫星互联网技术试验 or 通信技术试验, or if it is not named within 48 hours. GCAT is used only to settle which series a state-media name belongs to. The vehicle (LL2: Long March 2D, 'uncertain') does not change the rule. Resolved on a check after 10:00 UTC on 28 Nov 2026, or 48 hours after lift-off if the launch is later.
resolution.source: Xinhua, CCTV, CASC (spacechina.com), CNSA; GCAT (planet4589.org) for series membership
resolution.void_if: the launch matched to these closures (or to replacement notices for the same launch) does not lift off from Xichang between 26 Nov and 3 Dec 2026 (UTC)

reference.basis: Measured 21 Nov 2026 from GCAT and Launch's history (NotamForChina, Joey0609). Plain rule: Long March 2C/2D launches from Xichang at 34-36 deg since Sep 2017: 30 of 32 were a numbered Yaogan or Shiyan (28 Yaogan, 2 Shiyan); the other 2 were Xinjishu Shiyan, which this rule counts as No. For context: the 2-area ZPKM+ZGZU pattern with the far area at 567-572 NM: 4 of 5 since 2020 (Yaogan 42-01, Yaogan 43-03, Shiyan 30-01/02, Shiyan 30-03/04; the other was Einstein Probe, 29 deg, science). The same far ZGZU area on any vehicle: 8 of 9. All Long March 2D launches from Xichang since 2020: 19 of 23; the others were 1 Xinjishu Shiyan and 3 SatNet technology test launches (50 and 55 deg, a different pattern).
